title: First day of Ramadan
note: Begin fasting with intention; seek Qur'an and night prayer.

title: Laylat al-Qadr (seek in last ten nights)
note: Odd nights of last ten — especially 27th for many communities (follow your scholarship).

title: Eid al-Fitr
note: Takbir, charity (Zakat al-Fitr), prayer, and joy with family.

title: Eid al-Adha
note: Takbir days, sacrifice (where applicable), prayer, and sharing.

title: Islamic New Year
note: Not a religious 'Eid' in worship — a time for reflection and hijrah themes.

title: Ashura (10 Muharram)
note: Recommended fast of Muharram (9–10 or 10–11) per sunnah guidance.

title: Rabi al-Awwal 12 (birth date cited by many)
note: Scholars differ on celebration formats; increase salawat and learn sirah with adab.
